business_scope.primary_industry_name: Retail Sale via Automated Dropshipping Networks

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Bilateral Investment Treaty between Samoa and the People's Republic of China (signed 1997)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER) Plus
Double Taxation Agreement between Samoa and New Zealand (in force 2013)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act 1987 (as amended), Money Laundering and Proceeds of Crime Act 2007, Financial Intelligence Unit Act 2005, and International Companies (Beneficial Ownership) Regulations 2018

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the passport (bio-data page)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport issuing authority in the beneficial owner's country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (recent utility bill or bank statement)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider or regulated financial institution in the source country

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming good standing and banking relationship
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed commercial bank in the beneficial owner's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified certificate of incorporation and corporate register excerpt for any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry in the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against Samoa's domestic sanctions lists, the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN List, and EU consolidated list. Politically exposed persons require enhanced due diligence per the Money Laundering and Proceeds of Crime Act 2007 and Samoa International Financial Authority guidance. Senior management approval is mandatory for such persons and for individuals resident in high-risk third countries.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: MCIL Companies Registry Online Portal – International Companies Module (Samoa Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The official registry language is English. A company name may be in English, Samoan, or a foreign script such as Chinese, but a non-Latin script name must be accompanied by a certified transliteration into English or Samoan. The Latin-alphabet version is the controlling legal identifier.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If a name reservation is rejected, the applicant or its licensed registered agent may, within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice, submit a written appeal to the Registrar of International Companies via the MCIL Companies Registry, stating the grounds and proposing a revised name where appropriate. The Registrar will issue a determination within 7 working days. If the appeal is dismissed, a fresh name reservation may be filed. A further petition may be addressed to the Minister of Commerce, Industry and Labour.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted for International Companies provided a licensed Samoa registered agent and a registered office address in Samoa are retained. The automated dropshipping business may be operated entirely remotely; no physical operational premises in Samoa are required.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low – less than 5% annual probability for non-licensed, non-banking e-commerce entities; any unannounced inspection is directed at the registered agent's office rather than the company's overseas operational site.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing professional fee of registered agents in the Samoa international finance centre

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government incorporation fee for International Company
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the International Companies (Fees) Regulations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office and licensed registered agent service fee (first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate for registered agent services in Samoa

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour / Samoa International Financial Authority
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff under the International Companies (Fees) Regulations

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended by the International Companies Amendment Act 2008; ss. 4-10 (incorporation and registration), s. 8 (Memorandum and Articles), s. 11 (registered office and licensed registered agent), s. 75 (directors and officers).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form 1 (Application for Incorporation) together with executed Memorandum and Articles of Association and written consent of registered agent, filed with the Registrar of International Companies
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement; the International Company may be capitalized with shares of no par value, including zero issued shares. No escrow account is required for subscription proceeds. A statutory annual government fee of USD 100 applies after incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, by the sole incorporator and subscriber, that the incorporation of Samoa International Company (the 'Company') under the International Companies Act 1987 is hereby ratified and confirmed. RESOLVED FURTHER that the allotment and issuance of one (1) fully paid ordinary share of no par value to the founding shareholder be approved. RESOLVED FURTHER that the registered office at the office of the licensed registered agent in Apia, Samoa, be adopted as the Company's statutory address. RESOLVED FURTHER that [Director Name] and [Secretary Name] be appointed as the initial director and corporate secretary, respectively. RESOLVED FURTHER that electronic banking mandates and payment processor authorizations be established for the Company's automated dropshipping operations. RESOLVED FURTHER that all officers are authorized to execute all filings necessary to effectuate these resolutions.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engagement of Licensed Registered Agent and KYC Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SIFA-licensed registered agents (private licensed service providers monitored by the Samoa International Finance Authority)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute the registered agent engagement letter, complete shareholder and director know-your-customer (KYC) questionnaires, and submit beneficial ownership declarations. The agent will verify identity and conduct due diligence prior to accepting the engagement and will act as the statutory agent for service of process.
required_dossiers: Certified passport copy of each shareholder and director
Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement, dated within 3 months)
Bank reference letter or professional reference
Curriculum vitae and background declaration for each officer
Completed SIFA KYC and beneficial ownership forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If KYC is queried, provide notarized or apostilled supporting evidence and an explanatory statement to the registered agent; the agent may request an enhanced due diligence interview or alternate documentary proof, after which clearance is either granted or the engagement is declined and an alternate licensed agent may be substituted.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name availability search and reservation request through the registered agent. The proposed name must contain 'Limited' or 'Ltd.' as its final word and must not be identical or deceptively similar to an existing company name, trademark, or any name reserved on the SIFA register.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, the applicant may file an appeal or resubmit with an alternate name; if the name is blocked due to similarity, provide consent from the existing holder or adopt a distinguishing suffix/word to obtain approval.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application with Memorandum and Articles
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute and deliver Form 1 together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association, incorporating all statutory clauses (name, registered office, objects, share structure, and limitation of liability). The registered agent will file physically or via the SIFA electronic portal and pay the prescribed government fee of USD 200.
required_dossiers: Form 1 (Application for Incorporation), signed by the subscriber
Memorandum and Articles of Association, signed and dated
Consent of initial director to act
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SIFA issues a requisition for correction or additional information, the registered agent must respond within 14 days with amended documents or supplemental declarations; failure to cure within the statutory period requires a fresh filing with no refund of the government fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval of the application, SIFA issues the Certificate of Incorporation evidencing the legal existence of the International Company. The Company is then entered into the International Companies Register and becomes a separate legal entity with limited liability under the International Companies Act 1987.
required_dossiers: Filed Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate is lost or contains an error, file a written request with SIFA for a certified copy or a Certificate of Amendment; processing is completed within 2-3 business days upon payment of the prescribed replacement fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance and Share Register Setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors of the International Company, acting through the licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first meeting of the board (physical, telephonic, or by unanimous written resolution) to: adopt the issued shares and issue the share certificate, approve the appointment of directors and officers, adopt the corporate seal and banking/payment processor mandates, approve the opening of operational accounts with Stripe and PayPal, and direct the registered agent to maintain the statutory registers at the registered office.
required_dossiers: Bank and payment processor authorization forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If statutory registers are defective or incomplete, cure by retroactive unanimous written resolution of the board and re-execution of the relevant registers; late filing penalties may apply only if the annual government fee filing is missed, so immediate regularization of the share ledger is advised.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Samoa — acting solely as the general business licensing body; no specific industrial license applies to an International Company conducting remote automated dropshipping operations outside the domestic market of Samoa.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not required for automated dropshipping under the International Companies Act 1987 and SIFA regulatory framework; an optional MCIL General Business Licence would apply only if the International Company establishes a physical retail or warehousing premise within Samoa.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA), Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — the operation is an administrative, office-based digital retail activity with no manufacturing, storage, or physical goods processing footprint in Samoa; no EIA registration or full EIA report is mandated.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable for industrial discharge or VOC emissions. The Company and its registered agent must comply with the Waste Management Act 2005 (Samoa) for disposal of IT and electronic equipment, and with data protection obligations applicable to customer personal data. No wastewater discharge thresholds apply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification and building compliance clearance for the registered office premises, obtained from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (SFESA); occupational health and workplace safety obligations under the Labour and Employment Relations Act 2013 (Samoa) apply to any locally engaged staff; no civil defense clearance is required for purely remote operations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Samoa Revenue Authority (SRA) - official portal: https://www.sra.gov.ws
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Samoa International Company (IC) obtains a Tax Identification Number (TIN) by registering with the Samoa Revenue Authority (SRA) through its online taxpayer portal. The applicant submits a certified copy of the Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum and Articles of Association, trust deed (if any), and a completed SRA registration form. ICs are, however, exempt from income tax and VAGST on offshore activities; a Certificate of Tax Exemption can be issued by the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour / Registrar of International Companies. If the IC makes domestic taxable supplies or meets the turnover threshold, it is required to file a VAGST registration application within 14 days.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Samoa does not provide a check-the-box pass-through election under domestic tax law. An IC may voluntarily elect to register for VAGST to recover input tax on local expenses, but such election does not convert the IC's tax-exempt status into a taxable entity for income tax. No hybrid mismatch elections are available; the International Companies Act imposes an automatic statutory tax exemption on qualifying ICs, subject to compliance with anti-avoidance provisions.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, digital stamping or e-invoicing clearance mandate is currently enforced in Samoa. Registered persons must issue VAGST tax invoices in the prescribed form, retain them for seven years, and file electronic returns through the SRA online platform.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A VAGST-registered supplier may zero-rate exported goods if the goods are physically exported from Samoa within 28 days of supply and appropriate customs evidence is retained. Offshore services (including dropshipping facilitation, platform services and logistics coordination) supplied to a non-resident person who is outside Samoa at the time of supply and not connected with land/goods located in Samoa are also zero-rated. The claim must be supported by documentary proof of export or offshore recipient status.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Airway Bill
Inward Remittance Certificate / Bank Transfer Evidence for the cross-border settlement
VAGST Export Certificate or zero-rating attestation (where claimed)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent zero-rating claims or fictitious export documentation are subject to detailed audit scrutiny by the SRA. Penalties include recovery of any refunded VAGST plus interest (at the statutory rate), a civil penalty of up to 150% of the tax underpaid, a fine not exceeding WST 50,000, and imprisonment of up to seven years for responsible officers. The SRA may also suspend or cancel the entity's tax registration and require enhanced reporting for subsequent periods.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (Faletupe Tutotonu o Samoa)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan Tala (WST) is non-internationally traded and subject to a managed exchange rate arrangement. Current-account convertibility is granted for genuine trade transactions upon submission of documentary evidence, while capital-account transactions require prior Central Bank of Samoa approval under the Exchange Control Act 1955 and Exchange Control Regulations 1960. Profit remittances by an International Company require exchange-control clearance, evidence of after-tax available reserves, and are vulnerable to CBS liquidity checks; the CBS may impose queueing in times of foreign-exchange shortage. Samoa has no formal capital-account liberalization for offshore hedge funds or passive treasury vehicles, so repetitive funding and distributions are scrutinized to ensure the IC is not a mere conduit.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under Samoa's Exchange Control Regulations, export proceeds must be repatriated to Samoa within 90 days from the date of shipment. Every exporter must offer the foreign currency proceeds to an authorized dealer bank within 30 days of receipt; mandatory conversion into WST at the official exchange rate applies unless the Central Bank of Samoa grants a foreign-currency retention-account exemption. For an automated dropshipping operation, careful distinction must be made between 'export of goods' receipts and 'service fees' or 'sales commission' flows, as the latter may face stricter surrender requirements and require a separate CBS ruling.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility. Samoa does not license foreign-owned electronic money institutions for domestic WST settlement, and the Central Bank of Samoa treats any Samoa International Company holding client funds through an offshore EMI as a high-risk, non-transparent treasury arrangement. Offshore digital EMIs unlicensed in Samoa cannot provide compliant clearing through the local banking system and may create unlicensed banking or payment-services exposure. Such EMIs can only be used for low-value non-Samoan currency collection if the transaction path does not involve Samoan residents; this is impractical for an operating IC in Samoa.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In principle, Samoa International Companies may open accounts through a licensed registered agent and bank-introducer schemes without every director attending in person. However, all tier-1 banks currently apply enhanced due diligence and, as a practical risk-control, require at least one natural-person director or the appointed authorized signatory to attend an in-person identity verification interview in Apia or through a bank-approved notary/embassy channel. Remote video onboarding is accepted only for the initial copy review; the account remains unactivated until the physical or truly verified identification check is completed.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO and director names matching sanctions or PEP watchlists
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Color-certified passport copies, recent utility bill, corporate chart, certified certificate of incorporation, ICA written resolutions, negative press search results, and a detailed currency-of-wealth statement certified by an accountant.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High transaction velocity to unrelated jurisdictions inconsistent with traditional retail dropshipping
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed dropshipping supplier agreements, marketplace USA/UK/EU seller registration pages, live order-management dashboard login, settlement reports from Stripe/PayPal, and shipping-logistics invoices with tracking numbers proving physical goods flow.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Third-party capital injection or round-tripping in 'tax-haven' proceeds
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bank-issued source-of-funds letter from the originating shareholder, stamped contractual payout reports, executed share subscription documents, CBS exchange-control approval receipt, and legal opinion from Samoan counsel declaring the injection as equity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Discrepancy between declared 'automated dropshipping' business and actual settlement patterns involving digital goods or cryptocurrencies
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Detailed product catalogue demonstrating retail goods, gateway merchant category codes, refund chargeback analytics, supplier price lists, and a clear processing report showing via platforms such as Shopify/WooCommerce, proving no crypto conversion occurs.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital contributions and intercompany funding must be received by an authorized dealer bank in Samoa via SWIFT MT103 with proper purpose codes (e.g., 'Share Capital Contribution' or 'Loan Intercompany' with CBS reference). Prior approval from the Central Bank of Samoa is required for WST-equivalent amounts above 100,000 or for any unusually structured debt/equity hybrid; a signed Form A or approved Legal Tender Advice must be lodged. The bank will verify the underlying International Company Act 2012 registration, current directors, and that the source funds are easily identifiable. No domestic inward routing through EMI settlement or PayPal business balances will be accepted as the sole proof of injected liquidity.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlements must use the formal banking clearing rails: SWIFT MT103 will be executed for third-party supplier payments, and Commercial Letters of Credit (L/C at sight or usance) are recommended for high-value automated inventory acquisitions. Each disbursement requires an approved underlying commercial invoice, packing slip, shipping order or courier manifest, and a valid purpose code identifying dropshipped goods. Payments cannot be released to wholly unrelated shell payees; all payee names must match the supplier agreement. WST balances generated from export conversions can be used for operating costs, but margins held in WST are subject to regulatory 'at most 30 days' holding periods unless allocated for approved local expenses.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX forward contracts with authorized dealer banks for up to 12 months against bona fide underlying imports/exports
Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) in offshore markets for WST/USD exposure where the settlement amount is netted in USD outside Samoa
Currency swaps restricted to matching actual trade cash flows, executed only through an authorized dealer bank in Samoa with CBS transparency filings

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return and Government Fee Renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary of incorporation date; permitted 60-day grace period before late penalty accrues
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: 10% late penalty on unpaid fee after the grace period; failure to pay for 6 consecutive months activates administrative strike-off procedure, forfeiture of registered assets, and loss of legal capacity

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory independent audit applies to International Companies under the International Companies Act 1987, regardless of turnover or balance sheet size; audit becomes necessary only if shareholders resolve or a lender contractually requires it.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory accounting standard is prescribed; where financial statements are voluntarily prepared, IFRS is customarily adopted.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No separate public UBO filing exists; the registered agent is obligated to maintain current beneficial ownership records and to confirm their accuracy within the annual return, including any shareholding transfer during the year.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not applicable (no statutory audit); if voluntarily prepared, US$1,000 – US$2,500 per audit

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% (Samoa International Company statutory exemption; general resident corporate CIT rate is 27%)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Full income tax exemption for International Companies under the International Companies Act; no income tax, no capital gains tax, no estate duty, and no turnover or gross receipts tax on foreign-source income; exemption certificate available from Ministry of Revenue

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No Samoa CIT return form is prescribed for a tax-exempt International Company; compliance is satisfied via annual license renewal and exemption confirmation through the Samoa Ministry of Revenue e-Services portal and the Registrar of International Companies
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual (license and exemption renewal only; no quarterly or periodic CIT filings)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual license fee and tax exemption renewal due within 30 days after each incorporation anniversary; if the fiscal year is chosen in the articles, a written election must be filed with the Registrar before the first fiscal year-end

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered International Company name, registration number, and registered agent/office in Samoa
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter service address of the licensed registered agent; no Samoan tax ID required for non-resident beneficial owners

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised capital, issued shares, and class of shares
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State capital in Samoan tala or any permitted foreign currency; no minimum capital is required

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the company has not derived Samoan-source income and has not carried on business within Samoa during the renewal period
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be signed by a director or the registered agent; automated dropshipping sales routed outside Samoa should be affirmatively documented

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation by the licensed Samoan registered agent that the IC remains in good standing and qualifies for the tax exemption
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The registered agent must hold a valid International Company management license and must be engaged by non-resident beneficial owners

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late renewal penalty of 10% per month (or part month), capped at 100% of the annual government fee; automatic strike-off or deregistration, retroactive loss of tax exemption, reinstatement fee up to WST 750, and potential disqualification of the registered agent

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% on dividends paid by a Samoa International Company to non-resident shareholders (Samoa's domestic non-resident dividend withholding rate for conventional companies is 15%)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No withholding tax arises on IC distributions, so no treaty relief application is required in the ordinary course; if a foreign paying agent or treaty partner requests documentary proof, the beneficial owner must obtain a Samoa Tax Residence Certificate and an Income Tax Exemption Certificate from the Ministry of Revenue, then submit those documents together with the IC incorporation certificate to the payer or to Samoa's Ministry of Revenue on a standard WHT information form
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: Samoa domestic non-resident rate 15%; under several Samoan double tax agreements reduced to 0% or 10%; for a tax-exempt IC the effective rate is 0%. Interest: Samoa domestic non-resident rate 15%; treaty-reduced rates commonly 0% or 10%; for a tax-exempt IC the effective rate is 0%.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not triggered for a fully tax-exempt International Company; should the IC nonetheless become Samoa-taxable by earning Samoan-source income or trading locally, the Samoa Income Tax Act's arm's-length rules require a Transfer Pricing Documentary Certificate when related-party transactions exceed WST 2,000,000 per year and a Master File when aggregate connected transactions exceed WST 20,000,000 per year
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Samoa International Companies Act imposes no mandatory local economic substance test, and a pure offshore IC does not require employees or premises in Samoa; however, an IC that is managed and controlled from Samoa while claiming foreign tax exemption may be treated as resident for income tax purposes, creating a real substance exposure. Automated dropshipping arrangements should be structured to ensure procurement, storage, logistics, and board decision-making occur outside Samoa, and directors should avoid any factual nexus to Samoan customers or payment processing in order to preserve the exemption.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating an automated dropshipping network that generates Samoan-source income — for example by selling goods to customers in Samoa, maintaining a Samoan inventory warehouse, or using a Samoan payment gateway — while continuing to claim the International Company full tax exemption
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Retrospective assessment of the underlying income at the 27% corporate rate, a 100% late payment/persistence penalty, monetary penalties up to WST 100,000, deregistration of the International Company, and revocation of the income tax exemption certificate
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly and severally liable for the tax shortfall and penalties; where fraud or willful evasion is proved, directors may face criminal prosecution with imprisonment up to 5 years, travel bans, and asset seizure orders after the corporate veil is pierced

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the International Company merely as a collection vehicle for Stripe and PayPal receipts without any demonstrable business purpose, meaningful economic activity, or arm's-length arrangement with service providers, thereby creating a sham 'tax-exempt shell' for the dropshipping trade
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Deregistration under the International Companies Act, administrative strike-off, regulatory fines up to WST 50,000, forced repatriation or freezing of payment-rail assets, and disqualification of the registered agent
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Courts may disregard the limited liability structure and hold directors personally liable for creditor claims and regulatory penalties; personal asset tracing, charging orders, and director disqualification orders are available to the Samoa Registrar

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML/CFT Violations in Payment Rail Integration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Integrating Stripe and PayPal automated stores without maintaining a compliant AML/CFT framework, failing to perform customer due diligence, and omitting suspicious transaction reports involving the International Company account flow
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Samoa AML/CFT Act 2017, fines up to WST 500,000 for the corporate entity, cancellation of access to licensed payment aggregators, and freezing of funds; repeat violations trigger extradition and mutual legal assistance exposure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and compliance officers are personally subject to fines up to WST 100,000 and imprisonment up to 10 years; senior management may be banned from acting as directors and prohibited from leaving Samoa pending investigation
